name: Anna Robinson-Barella
role: Lecturer in Clinical Pharmacy and Health- and Medicines- Inequality
bio:
Anna is a Lecturer in Clinical Pharmacy and Health- and Medicines- Inequality, and is the Director for Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) and Director of Education, at Newcastle School of Pharmacy. She is also a Specialist Clinical Pharmacist, with a wealth of experience working in Primary and Secondary care settings across the North-East of England.

Anna's research interests lie in working with people from minoritised and marginalised communities. In particular, Anna's research seeks to target medicines- and health- inequalities.
